repos_data.description: Agentic AI memory with Ebbinghaus forgetting curve decay. +16pp better recall than Mem0 on LoCoMo.
Open-source persistent memory for AI agent pipelines (LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen) and Claude. REST API + knowledge graph + autonomous consolidation.
Memory system for autonomous agents - built by an agent, for agents
Persistent codebase knowledge layer for AI agents. Pre-builds architecture, dependency, coupling, and risk knowledge served via MCP. 27 languages, 13 tools.

Sophisticated AI chatbot with long-term memory capabilities, complete Notion workspace integration, and MCP (Model Context Protocol) implementation. Features semantic, episodic, and procedural memory systems.

Agent-MCP is a framework for creating multi-agent systems that enables coordinated, efficient AI collaboration through the Model Context Protocol (MCP). The system is designed for developers building AI applications that benefit from multiple specialized agents working in parallel on different aspects of a project.
Local, LLM-free memory for AI agents. A single offline Rust binary — deterministic and auditable — that learns from use, forgets the irrelevant, and strengthens what matters. No cloud, no API keys.
Zero context compaction for Claude Code & LLM agents. Persistent memory powered by OS primitives (demand paging, kswapd eviction, mlock pinning). Single SQLite file, MCP-native, multi-agent shared.
Give your AI agents persistent, collective memory — with deduplicating absorb, supersession lineage, semantic search, and a graph UI. Speaks MCP.
Shared, governed state layer for human-agent systems — deterministic, versioned, provenance-complete state with corrections, attribution, and audit
Persistent Intelligence Infrastructure for AI Agents
